function [SWS_LinIf_00528]
Std_ReturnType < User_Trigger Transmit>(PduIdType Tx PduId, PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr)Sync/ Async Synchronous;

Within this API, the upper layer module (called module) shall check whether the available data fits into the b uffer size reported by Pdu Info Ptr - >Sdu Length. If it fits, it shall copy its data into the buffer provided by Pdu Info Ptr - >Sdu Data Ptr and update the length of the actual copied data in Pdu Info Ptr - >Sdu Length. If not, it returns E_ NOT_ OK without ch anging Pdu Info Ptr.
